title: Monitoring extra-vascular migratory metastasis \(EVMM) of migrating cancer cells using an in vitro co-culture system
protocol: Maintain human umbilical vein endothelial cells in MCDB-131 Complete Media and passage them 1:10 every 72-96 hours at 90% confluency in 10cm² tissue culture plates using 2mL of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA.
Split HUVEC-2 cells into multiple 15cm² plates and freeze them in 10% DMSO/MCDB-131 freezing media at passage four.
Add 50 μl of liquefied Basement Membrane Extract or BME to wells of a clear-bottom 96-well tissue culture plate and permit it to solidify for thirty minutes at 37°C.
Seed HUVEC-2 cells atop the membrane at a density of 15,000 cells/well in 100 μl of MCDB-131 enriched with 2 mM L-glutamine, 1 mg/mL hydrocortisone, and 10 ng/mL EGF.
Culture HUVEC-2 cells overnight at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO₂/95% air atmosphere to allow for tubule formation.
Observe tubule formation 12-16 hours post-seeding.
Passage GFP-labeled Human melanoma cancer cells such that they will be ~80% confluent in 24 h.
Harvest 80% confluent C8161-GFP from a 25-cm2 flask.
Warm PBS and trypsin–EDTA in the 37 °C water bath.
Remove and discard media from the 25-cm2 flask with C8161-GFP cells.
Rinse cells with PBS.
Add 1 ml of trypsin–EDTA to the flask, then incubate at 37 °C for a few minutes.
Tap the side of the flask to ensure cell detachment.
Add 1 ml of supplemented growth medium and gently pipette up and down to create a single-cell suspension.
Transfer the cell suspension into a sterile 15 ml conical tube.
Mix 5 μl of cell suspension with 5 μl of Trypan blue for viability determination using a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge cells at 200 g for 3 min in a centrifuge with a swing-bucket rotor.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in MCDB-131 Complete Media.
Gently pipette up and down to obtain a single-cell suspension.
Add GFP-transfected C8161 human melanoma cells to wells containing HUVEC-2 tubules and BME at a density of 3500 cells/well using 50 μl of MCDB-131 Complete Media.
